Almamlaka TV Digital Expansion Initiative — Budget & Timeline Breakdown
1. Quarterly Budget Allocation
The table below outlines the approved budget allocation per quarter for the Digital Expansion
Initiative, covering platform development, marketing, and operations.
|Quarter|Development|Marketing|Operations|Total|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Q1 2027|$450,000|$120,000|$60,000|$630,000|
|Q2 2027|$500,000|$150,000|$70,000|$720,000|
|Q3 2027|$400,000|$100,000|$60,000|$560,000|
|Q4 2027|$350,000|$90,000|$50,000|$490,000|
|**Total**|**$1,700,000**|**$460,000**|**$240,000**|**$2,400,000**|

Almamlaka TV Digital Expansion Initiative — Budget & Timeline Breakdown
2. Budget Notes
Note that the figures above reflect the originally approved budget. Following a revision by the
Finance Committee in December 2026, the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000 to
account for additional smart TV integration costs not included in the original scope.

Almamlaka TV Digital Expansion Initiative — Budget & Timeline Breakdown
3. Project Timeline
|Milestone|Target Date|
|---|---|
|Requirements finalized|Jan 10, 2027|
|Mobile app design freeze|Feb 5, 2027|
|Development complete|Mar 1, 2027|
|QA & testing|Mar 1 - Mar 20, 2027|
|Public launch|March 15, 2027|
|Post-launch review|Jun 15, 2027|

Almamlaka TV Digital Expansion Initiative — Budget & Timeline Breakdown
4. Risk Notes
The QA and testing phase has limited buffer time. Any delay in development completion beyond
March 1, 2027 poses a direct risk to the public launch date. The Engineering team has flagged
smart TV integration testing as the highest-risk item on the timeline.

Almamlaka TV Digital Expansion Initiative — Project Overview Document
1. Introduction
Almamlaka TV is launching a new initiative called the Digital Expansion Initiative (DEI), aimed at
modernizing the channel's digital presence across streaming, mobile, and social platforms. This
document outlines the project's scope, goals, and key stakeholders.

Almamlaka TV Digital Expansion Initiative — Project Overview Document
2. Project Goals
The primary goal of the DEI is to increase digital viewership by 40% within the first year of launch.
Secondary goals include improving content discoverability, modernizing the mobile application,
and establishing a unified content management system across all platforms.

Almamlaka TV Digital Expansion Initiative — Project Overview Document
3. Key Details
Project Lead: Sara Al-Rashid
Total Approved Budget: $2,400,000
Planned Launch Date: March 15, 2027
Project Duration: 14 months

Almamlaka TV Digital Expansion Initiative — Project Overview Document
4. Platform Scope
The initiative covers three main platforms: the Almamlaka TV mobile application (iOS and
Android), the web streaming portal, and integration with third-party smart TV platforms. Each
platform will receive a redesigned user interface aligned with the updated Almamlaka TV brand
guidelines.
As part of the accessibility improvements, the mobile application will support content and subtitles
in 12 languages, including Arabic, English, French, and Spanish, with plans to expand to
additional languages in future phases.

Almamlaka TV Digital Expansion Initiative — Project Overview Document
5. Stakeholders
The project is sponsored by the Almamlaka TV Digital Strategy Department and overseen by a
steering committee consisting of representatives from Engineering, Content, Marketing, and Legal
& Compliance.

Almamlaka TV Digital Expansion Initiative — Project Overview Document
6. Success Metrics
Success will be measured through monthly active users (MAU), average session duration, app
store ratings, and content engagement rates. A quarterly review will be conducted by the steering
committee to track progress against these metrics.

Almamlaka TV Digital Expansion Initiative — Team & Governance Document
2. Governance Structure
The steering committee meets bi-weekly to review project status, budget utilization, and risk items.
Decisions requiring budget changes above $50,000 must be approved by the Finance Committee
before implementation.

Almamlaka TV Digital Expansion Initiative — Team & Governance Document
3. Revised Launch Date
Following the steering committee meeting on January 20, 2027, the public launch date was moved
to April 1, 2027 to allow additional time for smart TV integration testing, which was identified as a
high-risk item in the project timeline.

Almamlaka TV Digital Expansion Initiative — Team & Governance Document
4. Data Privacy Policy
All user data collected through the mobile application and streaming portal will be handled in
accordance with applicable data protection regulations. User data will not be shared with third
parties without explicit consent, except where required by law.

Almamlaka TV Digital Expansion Initiative — Team & Governance Document
5. Content Moderation Policy
User-generated comments and interactions on the platform are subject to Almamlaka TV's content
moderation guidelines. Content that violates community standards will be removed, and repeat
violations may result in account suspension.

Almamlaka TV Digital Expansion Initiative — Team & Governance Document
6. Escalation Contacts
For technical escalations, contact the Engineering Lead. For budget or scope changes, escalate to
the Project Lead, who will bring the item to the steering committee for review.
